Maria S: quick morning standup — pipeline + sec asks. What I did: demo with NovaHealth yesterday, execs liked flow. Blockers: procurement flagged BYO-KMS/HSM details and legal wants explicit EU data residency. Today: sync with eng + SE, draft SOW, gather compliance fields.

Alex AE: noted. For NovaHealth: do we have an ETA on starting the Dedicated pilot? They specifically asked about HSM throughput and region pinning.

Samir: SE notes — we scoped HSM options earlier. Need clarification: keywrap vs raw key import. If they want BYOK with import, we need HSM support + connector; if only key-wrapping, a KMS proxy could work. Also FYI latency impact ~10-15ms/call.

Tia: Tia: security side — please fill out the compliance questionnaire. Also confirm where HSM audit logs should land: customer-managed S3 or Redwood-managed? If customer, need bucket ARN + org-id.

Jon P: Jon P: I'll own the SOW and the HSM wiring diagram. @Tia can you paste the exact fields you need here? @Samir can you drop the short integration summary for the SOW?

Samir: Samir: short snippet to paste into SOW: ```KMS options: 1) BYOK (import key) — requires HSM connector; 2) KMS proxy (wrap/unwrap) — lower latency; 3) HSM-onprem connector — full control. Note: expected token-latency +10-15ms for BYOK import path.```

Tia: Tia: required fields: customer_bucket_arn, kms_provider, key_wrap_method, audit_log_s3_prefix, retention_policy_days. If they want HSM audit kept in-house, we need their retention policy doc.

SecBot: SecBot: Security intake submitted (NovaHealth) by Maria S — intake ID: NH-2026. SLA: please confirm intake items within 48h.

Maria S: Maria S: will collect answers from customer by EOD. Legal also wants confirmation Dedicated can be region-pinned to EU. @Alex can we confirm feasibility?

Alex AE: Alex AE: yes, region pinning is supported for Dedicated. I'll confirm infra lead and update by 2pm PDT.

Jon P: Jon P: quick CR ping — PR #482 in docs (dedicated onboarding) needs a brief review, small wording tweak in KMS section. @Samir can you glance?

Samir: Samir: will review in the next hour. Also adding a short note about automatic fallback to hosted model if Dedicated HSM capacity is exhausted (to avoid silent failures).

Maria S: Maria S: thanks everyone. Today's plan: gather compliance fields, finalize SOW draft, schedule 30m with Jon for wiring diagram. I'll update thread after customer response. :thumbsup:
